result.reason: Provision defines a 60% asset composition test, needing total assets, list of qualifying categories, and timing as inputs to produce a threshold determination.
result.inputs: total assets of the entity; enumerated qualifying asset categories (cash, government obligations, deposits, specified loan types, REMIC interests, etc.)
result.condition: measured at the close of the taxable year
result.output: whether at least 60 percent of total assets consists of the enumerated qualifying assets
